Each rank keeps its block rows as a contiguous\n//             local matrix (nloc x n, row-major) in GPU memory.\n//   * CUDA  : all numerical work (panel factorization, triangular solves, the\n//             trailing symmetric rank-NB update, matrix generation, validation\n//             reconstruction) runs in custom CUDA kernels on the GPU assigned to\n//             the rank (round-robin over the devices visible on the node).\n//   * OpenMP: host-side work (block-cyclic <-> global reordering of gathered\n//             data, reductions) is multithreaded.\n//\n// Right-looking blocked algorithm, for every block column k:\n//   1. owner rank factorizes the diagonal block L_kk on its GPU\n//   2. L_kk is broadcast to all ranks\n//   3. every rank computes L_ik = A_ik L_kk^{-T} for its block rows i > k\n//   4. the block column L_{*k} is all-gathered\n//   5. every rank updates its rows of the trailing matrix on the GPU:\n//      A_ij -= L_ik L_jk^T   (k < j <= i, lower triangle only)\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Configuration\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic constexpr int NB = 512;   // GEMM tile (cols)\nstatic constexpr int TK = 16;   // GEMM tile (depth)\nstatic constexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                               \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                               \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n#define MPI_CHECK(call)                                                   \\\n    do {                                                                  \\\n        int err__ = (call);                                               \\\n        if (err__ != MPI_SUCCESS) {                                       \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MPI error %d at %s:%d\\n\", err__, __FILE__, __LINE__); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                 \\\n        }                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Block-cyclic row distribution helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstruct Dist {\n    int P;          // number of ranks\n    int r;          // this rank\n    size_t n;       // matrix size\n    int nblk;       // number of global block rows\n    int nlocblk;    // number of local block rows\n    size_t nloc;    // number of local rows\n};\n\nstatic inline size_t blockRows(const Dist& d, int I) {\n    return std::min<size_t>(NB, d.n - (size_t)I * NB);\n}\n// global row index of local row i on rank q\nstatic inline size_t globalRow(const Dist& d, int q, size_t i) {\n    return ((i / NB) * d.P + q) * (size_t)NB + i % NB;\n}\n// number of local block rows of rank q\nstatic inline int localBlocks(const Dist& d, int q) {\n    return (d.nblk > q) ? (d.nblk - q + d.P - 1) / d.P : 0;\n}\nstatic inline size_t localRows(const Dist& d, int q) {\n    size_t rows = 0;\n    for (int lb = 0; lb < localBlocks(d, q); ++lb) rows += blockRows(d, lb * d.P + q);\n    return rows;\n}\n// first local row of rank q whose global block index is > k\nstatic inline size_t firstLocalRowAfter(const Dist& d, int q, int k) {\n    int lb = k / d.P + (q > k % d.P ? 0 : 1);\n    return (size_t)lb * NB;\n}\n\n// Reorder a buffer that holds the local matrices of all ranks back to back\n// (rank 0's rows, rank 1's rows, ...) into global row order.  Rows have\n// `ncols` entries.  Used for the final gather and for validation.\nstatic void blockCyclicToGlobal(const Dist& d, const double* staged, const std::vector<size_t>& rankRowOffset,\n                                double* global, size_t ncols) {\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n    for (int I = 0; the global\n// row of C's local row i is derived from the block-cyclic distribution.\ntemplate <bool SUBTRACT>\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(GEMM_THREADS)\ngemm_nt_kernel(int M, int N, int K, const double* __restrict__ A, size_t lda, const double* __restrict__ B,\n               size_t ldb, double* __restrict__ C, size_t ldc, int skip, size_t rowbase, int P, int r,\n               size_t colbase) {\n    const int m0 = blockIdx.y * TM;\n    const int n0 = blockIdx.x * TN;\n\n    if (skip) {\n        const size_t i = rowbase + (size_t)min(m0 + TM - 1, M - 1);\n        const size_t g = ((i / NB) * P + r) * (size_t)NB + i % NB;\n        if (colbase + (size_t)n0 > g) return;\n    }\n\n    __shared__ double As[TK][TM + 1];\n    __shared__ double Bs[TK][TN + 1];\n\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = tid >> 4; B[(size_t)gn * ldb + gk] : 0.0;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int kk = 0; kk < TK; ++kk) {\n            double a[4], b[4];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) a[i] = As[kk][ty + 16 * i];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) b[j] = Bs[kk][tx + 16 * j];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)\n#pragma unroll\n                for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) acc[i][j] = fma(a[i], b[j], acc[i][j]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {\n        const int row = m0 + ty + 16 * i;\n        if (row >= M) continue;\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j) {\n            const int col = n0 + tx + 16 * j;\n            if (col >= N) continue;\n            double* c = C + (size_t)row * ldc + col;\n            if (SUBTRACT)\n                *c -= acc[i][j];\n            else\n                *c = acc[i][j];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Unblocked in-place Cholesky factorization of a small m x m (m <= IB) block\n// held in shared memory.  One thread block.  Only the lower triangle is read\n// and written.  On a non-positive pivot the global diagonal index is stored in\n// *flag (if none was stored before) and the kernel stops.\n__global__ void potrf_small_kernel(double* __restrict__ D, size_t ld, int m, unsigned long long gdiag,\n                                   long long* flag) {\n    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n    __shared__ int fail;\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int nt = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < m * m; idx += nt) {\n        const int i = idx / m, c = idx % m;\n        if (c <= i) s[i][c] = D[(size_t)i * ld + c];\n    }\n    if (tid == 0) fail = 0;\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int j = 0; j < m; ++j) {\n        if (tid == 0) {\n            const double v = s[j][j];\n            if (v <= 0.0) {\n                fail = 1;\n                if (*flag < 0) *flag = (long long)(gdiag + j);\n            } else {\n                s[j][j] = sqrt(v);\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n        if (fail) break;\n        const double d = s[j][j];\n        for (int i = j + 1 + tid; i < m; i += nt) s[i][j] /= d;\n        __syncthreads();\n        // rank-1 update of the trailing lower triangle\n        const int rem = m - j - 1;\n        for (int idx = tid; idx < rem * rem; idx += nt) {\n            const int i = j + 1 + idx / rem;\n            const int c = j + 1 + idx % rem;\n            if (c <= i) s[i][c] -= s[i][j] * s[c][j];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int idx = tid; idx < m * m; idx += nt) {\n        const int i = idx / m, c = idx % m;\n        if (c <= i) D[(size_t)i * ld + c] = s[i][c];\n    }\n}\n\n// Solve X * L^T = B in place for M rows (X overwrites B), where L is a small\n// m x m (m <= IB) lower triangular block.  One thread per row.\n__global__ void trsm_small_kernel(const double* __restrict__ L, size_t ldl, int m, double* __restrict__ X,\n                                  size_t ldx, int M) {\n    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < m * m; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int i = idx / m, c = idx % m;\n        if (c <= i) s[i][c] = L[(size_t)i * ldl + c];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const int row = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (row >= M) return;\n    double* x = X + (size_t)row * ldx;\n\n    double v[IB];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int t = 0; t < IB; ++t) v[t] = (t < m) ? x[t] : 0.0;\n\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int c = 0; c < IB; ++c) {\n        if (c < m) {\n            double acc = v[c];\n#pragma unroll\n            for (int t = 0; t < c; ++t) acc -= v[t] * s[c][t];\n            v[c] = acc / s[c][c];\n        }\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int t = 0; t < IB; ++t)\n        if (t < m) x[t] = v[t];\n}\n\n// Zero the strictly upper triangular part of the local block-cyclic matrix.\n__global__ void zero_upper_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t nloc, size_t n, int P, int r) {\n    const size_t col = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t i = blockIdx.y;\n    if (i >= nloc || col >= n) return;\n    const size_t g = ((i / NB) * P + r) * (size_t)NB + i % NB;\n    if (col > g) A[i * n + col] = 0.0;\n}\n\n// Add n to the diagonal of the local rows (matrix generation).\n__global__ void add_diag_kernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t nloc, size_t n, int P, int r) {\n    const size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= nloc) return;\n    const size_t g = ((i / NB) * P + r) * (size_t)NB + i % NB;\n    A[i * n + g] += (double)n;\n}\n\n// Per-block maximum absolute / relative error between two local matrices.\n__global__ void error_kernel(const double* __restrict__ R, const double* __restrict__ A, size_t count,\n                             double* __restrict__ partialAbs, double* __restrict__ partialRel) {\n    __shared__ double sAbs[256];\n    __shared__ double sRel[256];\n    double mAbs = 0.0, mRel = 0.0;\n    for (size_t i = (size_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x; i < count; i += (size_t)gridDim.x * blockDim.x) {\n        const double err = fabs(R[i] - A[i]);\n        mAbs = fmax(mAbs, err);\n        mRel = fmax(mRel, err / (fabs(A[i]) + 1e-10));\n    }\n    sAbs[threadIdx.x] = mAbs;\n    sRel[threadIdx.x] = mRel;\n    __syncthreads();\n    for (int s = blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {\n        if ((int)threadIdx.x < s) {\n            sAbs[threadIdx.x] = fmax(sAbs[threadIdx.x], sAbs[threadIdx.x + s]);\n            sRel[threadIdx.x] = fmax(sRel[threadIdx.x], sRel[threadIdx.x + s]);\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        partialAbs[blockIdx.x] = sAbs[0];\n        partialRel[blockIdx.x] = sRel[0];\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Kernel launch helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ntemplate <bool SUBTRACT>\nstatic void gemm_nt(int M, int N, int K, const double* A, size_t lda, const double* B, size_t ldb, double* C,\n                    size_t ldc, cudaStream_t stream, bool skip = false, size_t rowbase = 0, int P = 1, int r = 0,\n                    size_t colbase = 0) {\n    if (M <= 0 || N <= 0 || K <= 0) return;\n    dim3 grid((N + TN - 1) / TN, (M + TM - 1) / TM);\n    gemm_nt_kernel<SUBTRACT><<<grid, GEMM_THREADS, 0, stream>>>(M, N, K, A, lda, B, ldb, C, ldc, skip ? 1 : 0,\n                                                                rowbase, P, r, colbase);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n}\n\n// Blocked triangular solve X * L^T = X for M rows, where L is the bk x bk lower\n// triangular block (leading dimension ldl) and X has leading dimension ldx.\nstatic void trsm_panel(const double* L, size_t ldl, int bk, double* X, size_t ldx, int M, cudaStream_t stream) {\n    if (M <= 0) return;\n    for (int j = 0; j < bk; j += IB) {\n        const int jb = std::min(IB, bk - j);\n        const int blocks = (M + 255) / 256;\n        trsm_small_kernel<<<blocks, 256, 0, stream>>>(L + (size_t)j * ldl + j, ldl, jb, X + j, ldx, M);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        if (j + jb < bk) {\n            // X[:, j+jb..bk] -= X[:, j..j+jb] * L[j+jb..bk, j..j+jb]^T\n            gemm_nt<true>(M, bk - j - jb, jb, X + j, ldx, L + (size_t)(j + jb) * ldl + j, ldl, X + j + jb, ldx,\n                          stream);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// In-place Cholesky factorization of the bk x bk diagonal block D (ld).\nstatic void potrf_block(double* D, size_t ld, int bk, size_t gdiag, long long* dflag, cudaStream_t stream) {\n    for (int j = 0; j < bk; j += IB) {\n        const int jb = std::min(IB, bk - j);\n        double* Djj = D + (size_t)j * ld + j;\n        potrf_small_kernel<<<1, 256, 0, stream>>>(Djj, ld, jb, (unsigned long long)(gdiag + j), dflag);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        if (j + jb < bk) {\n            const int rem = bk - j - jb;\n            double* Dbelow = D + (size_t)(j + jb) * ld + j;\n            trsm_small_kernel<<<(rem + 255) / 256, 256, 0, stream>>>(Djj, ld, jb, Dbelow, ld, rem);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            gemm_nt<true>(rem, rem, jb, Dbelow, ld, Dbelow, ld, D + (size_t)(j + jb) * ld + j + jb, ld, stream);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// dA : local block-cyclic rows on the device (nloc x n, row-major)\n// Returns true on success; on failure `failIndex` holds the global diagonal\n// index of the first non-positive pivot (consistent on all ranks).\nbool choleskyDecomposition(const Dist& d, double* dA, cudaStream_t stream, size_t& failIndex) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const int P = d.P, r = d.r;\n\n    // device buffers\n    double* dLkk = nullptr;   // NB*NB + 1 (last entry carries the pivot flag)\n    double* hPanelLoc = nullptr;  // local rows of the block column (packed)\n    double* hPanelAll = nullptr;  // gathered block column (rank order)\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hLkk, ((size_t)NB * NB + 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelLoc, std::max<size_t>(1, d.nloc) * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&hPanelAll, std::max<size_t>(1, n) * NB * sizeof(double)));\n\n    std::vector<int> counts(P), displs(P);\n    bool ok = true;\n    failIndex = 0;\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < d.nblk && ok; ++k) {\n        const size_t kb = (size_t)k * NB;\n        const int bk = (int)blockRows(d, k);\n        const int owner = k % P;\n        const size_t ldW = (size_t)bk;\n\n        // 1. factorize the diagonal block on the owner\n        if (r == owner) {\n            double* D = dA + ((size_t)(k / P) * NB) * n + kb;\n            potrf_block(D, n, bk, kb, dflag, stream);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(hLkk, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), D, n * sizeof(double),\n                                         (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), bk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            long long flag = -1;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&flag, dflag, sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, stream));\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n            hLkk[(size_t)bk * bk] = (double)flag;\n        }\n\n        // 2. broadcast L_kk (+ pivot flag)\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(hLkk, bk * bk + 1, MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n        {\n            const double flag = hLkk[(size_t)bk * bk];\n            if (flag >= 0.0) {\n                failIndex = (size_t)flag;\n                ok = false;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if (k + 1 == d.nblk) break; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg7RRfmDP5axtfVkXwTKx","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_012yWpQFQaGwcaGnPGGg8vEL","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/newfunc.cpp <<'EOF'\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// dA : local block-cyclic rows on the device (nloc x n, row-major)\n// Returns true on success; on failure `failIndex` holds the global diagonal\n// index of the first non-positive pivot (consistent on all ranks).\n//\n// Lookahead: the trailing update of step k is split into the next block\n// column (needed by panel k+1) and the rest.  The next block column is updated\n// on the high priority panel stream, so panel k+1 (factorization, broadcast,\n// triangular solves, all-gather) overlaps with the bulk update of step k that\n// runs on the second stream.\nnamespace {\n\nstruct PanelState {\n    const Dist& d;\n    double* dA;\n    cudaStream_t sPanel;\n    double* dLkk;        // broadcast diagonal block, NB x NB (ld NB)\n    double* dW[2];       // gathered block column, global row order, n x NB (ld bk)\n    long long* dflag;    // non-positive pivot flag\n    double* hLkk;        // NB*NB + 1 (last entry carries the pivot flag)\n    double* hPanelLoc;   // local rows of the block column (packed)\n    double* hPanelAll;   // gathered block column (rank order)\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n};\n\n// Factorize panel k: diagonal block on the owner, broadcast, triangular solves\n// of the local rows below, all-gather of the block column into dW[k % 2].\n// Everything is enqueued on sPanel; returns false on a non-positive pivot.\nbool factorizePanel(PanelState& st, int k, size_t& failIndex) {\n    const Dist& d = st.d;\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const int P = d.P, r = d.r;\n    const size_t kb = (size_t)k * NB;\n    const int bk = (int)blockRows(d, k);\n    const int owner = k % P;\n    const size_t ldW = (size_t)bk;\n    cudaStream_t s = st.sPanel;\n\n    // 1. factorize the diagonal block on the owner\n    if (r == owner) {\n        double* D = st.dA + ((size_t)(k / P) * NB) * n + kb;\n        potrf_block(D, n, bk, kb, st.dflag, s);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(st.hLkk, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), D, n * sizeof(double),\n                                     (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), bk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n        long long flag = -1;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(&flag, st.dflag, sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n        st.hLkk[(size_t)bk * bk] = (double)flag;\n    }\n\n    // 2. broadcast L_kk (+ pivot flag)\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(st.hLkk, bk * bk + 1, MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    {\n        const double flag = st.hLkk[(size_t)bk * bk];\n        if (flag >= 0.0) {\n            failIndex = (size_t)flag;\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    if (k + 1 == d.nblk) return true;  // nothing below the last diagonal block\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.dLkk, st.hLkk, (size_t)bk * bk * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n\n    // 3. triangular solves for the local rows below the diagonal block\n    const size_t lstart = firstLocalRowAfter(d, r, k);\n    const int Mloc = (lstart < d.nloc) ? (int)(d.nloc - lstart) : 0;\n    double* Xloc = st.dA + lstart * n + kb;\n    trsm_panel(st.dLkk, bk, bk, Xloc, n, Mloc, s);\n\n    // 4. all-gather the block column\n    if (Mloc > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(st.hPanelLoc, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Xloc, n * sizeof(double),\n                                     (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Mloc, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_contiguous(bk, MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_commit(&rowType));\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < P; ++q) {\n        const size_t ls = firstLocalRowAfter(d, q, k);\n        const size_t nl = localRows(d, q);\n        st.counts[q] = (ls < nl) ? (int)(nl - ls) : 0;\n        st.displs[q] = total;\n        total += st.counts[q];\n    }\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(st.hPanelLoc, Mloc, rowType, st.hPanelAll, st.counts.data(), st.displs.data(),\n                             rowType, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_free(&rowType));\n\n    // unpack into global row order on the device: one copy per block row\n    const size_t colbase = kb + bk;  // global index of the first trailing row/col\n    double* dW = st.dW[k % 2];\n    for (int I = k + 1; I < d.nblk; ++I) {\n        const int q = I % P;\n        const int lb = I / P;\n        const size_t srcRow = (size_t)st.displs[q] + ((size_t)lb * NB - firstLocalRowAfter(d, q, k));\n        const size_t dstRow = (size_t)I * NB - colbase;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW + dstRow * ldW, st.hPanelAll + srcRow * ldW,\n                                   blockRows(d, I) * ldW * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(const Dist& d, double* dA, cudaStream_t sPanel, cudaStream_t sUpdate,\n                           size_t& failIndex) {\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const int P = d.P, r = d.r;\n\n    PanelState st{d, dA, sPanel, nullptr, {nullptr, nullptr}, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr, nullptr,\n                  std::vector<int>(P), std::vector<int>(P)};\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&st.dLkk, (size_t)NB * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&st.dW[0], (size_t)n * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&st.dW[1], (size_t)n * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&st.dflag, sizeof(long long)));\n    const long long minusOne = -1;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.dflag, &minusOne, sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, sPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&st.hLkk, ((size_t)NB * NB + 1) * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&st.hPanelLoc, std::max<size_t>(1, d.nloc) * NB * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMallocHost(&st.hPanelAll, std::max<size_t>(1, n) * NB * sizeof(double)));\n\n    cudaEvent_t evPanel, evBulk;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evPanel, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventCreateWithFlags(&evBulk, cudaEventDisableTiming));\n\n    failIndex = 0;\n    bool ok = factorizePanel(st, 0, failIndex);\n\n    for (int k = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg7S2qQ8BkiEqC2D2EXNz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_014UBM12mtGR7ASPcFD4GrXf","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cat > /tmp/newfunc2.cpp <<'EOF'\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// dA : local block-cyclic rows on the device (nloc x n, row-major)\n// Returns true on success; on failure `failIndex` holds the global diagonal\n// index of the first non-positive pivot (consistent on all ranks).\n//\n// Lookahead: the trailing update of step k is split into the next block\n// column (needed by panel k+1) and the rest.  The next block column is updated\n// on the high priority panel stream (the diagonal block first, so its owner\n// can factorize and broadcast it immediately), and panel k+1 (factorization,\n// broadcast, triangular solves, exchange of the block column) overlaps with\n// the bulk update of step k that runs on the second stream.\n//\n// Block column exchange: when all ranks share a node the packed block column\n// is exchanged through an MPI shared memory window (one device-to-host copy by\n// the producer, direct host-to-device copies by every consumer).  Otherwise a\n// host-staged MPI_Allgatherv is used.\nnamespace {\n\nstruct PanelState {\n    const Dist& d;\n    double* dA;\n    cudaStream_t sPanel;\n    double* dLkk;        // broadcast diagonal block, NB x NB (ld NB)\n    double* dW[2];       // gathered block column, global row order, n x NB (ld bk)\n    long long* dflag;    // non-positive pivot flag\n    double* hLkk;        // NB*NB + 1 (last entry carries the pivot flag)\n    double* hPanelLoc;   // local rows of the block column (packed) - allgather path\n    double* hPanelAll;   // gathered block column (rank order)     - allgather path\n    cudaEvent_t evDiag;  // diagonal block of the current panel copied to the host\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n    // shared memory exchange path\n    bool useShm = false;\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm = MPI_COMM_NULL;\n    MPI_Win win = MPI_WIN_NULL;\n    std::vector<double*> seg;   // seg[q]: rank q's segment, 2 x nloc(q) x NB doubles\n    std::vector<size_t> segRows;\n};\n\n// local row index of the diagonal block of block column k on its owner\ninline size_t diagLocalRow(int k, int P) { return (size_t)(k / P) * NB; }\n\n// Owner: factorize the diagonal block of block column k and copy it to the\n// host (asynchronously on sPanel, evDiag is recorded afterwards).\nvoid panelDiag(PanelState& st, int k) {\n    const Dist& d = st.d;\n    if (d.r != k % d.P) return;\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const size_t kb = (size_t)k * NB;\n    const int bk = (int)blockRows(d, k);\n    double* D = st.dA + diagLocalRow(k, d.P) * n + kb;\n    potrf_block(D, n, bk, kb, st.dflag, st.sPanel);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(st.hLkk, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), D, n * sizeof(double),\n                                 (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), bk, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, st.sPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.hLkk + (size_t)bk * bk, st.dflag, sizeof(long long), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost,\n                               st.sPanel));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventRecord(st.evDiag, st.sPanel));\n}\n\n// Broadcast the diagonal block, triangular solves of the local rows below it,\n// exchange of the block column into dW[k % 2].  Returns false on a\n// non-positive pivot.\nbool panelRest(PanelState& st, int k, size_t& failIndex) {\n    const Dist& d = st.d;\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    const int P = d.P, r = d.r;\n    const size_t kb = (size_t)k * NB;\n    const int bk = (int)blockRows(d, k);\n    const int owner = k % P;\n    const size_t ldW = (size_t)bk;\n    cudaStream_t s = st.sPanel;\n\n    // 1./2. broadcast L_kk (+ pivot flag stored as long long in the last slot)\n    if (r == owner) CUDA_CHECK(cudaEventSynchronize(st.evDiag));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Bcast(st.hLkk, bk * bk + 1, MPI_DOUBLE, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    {\n        long long flag;\n        memcpy(&flag, st.hLkk + (size_t)bk * bk, sizeof(long long));\n        if (flag >= 0) {\n            failIndex = (size_t)flag;\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    if (k + 1 == d.nblk) return true;  // nothing below the last diagonal block\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(st.dLkk, st.hLkk, (size_t)bk * bk * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n\n    // 3. triangular solves for the local rows below the diagonal block\n    const size_t lstart = firstLocalRowAfter(d, r, k);\n    const int Mloc = (lstart < d.nloc) ? (int)(d.nloc - lstart) : 0;\n    double* Xloc = st.dA + lstart * n + kb;\n    trsm_panel(st.dLkk, bk, bk, Xloc, n, Mloc, s);\n\n    // 4. exchange the block column\n    const size_t colbase = kb + bk;  // global index of the first trailing row/col\n    double* dW = st.dW[k % 2];\n\n    if (st.useShm) {\n        // producer: pack the local rows into the own shared segment\n        double* mySeg = st.seg[r] + (size_t)(k % 2) * st.segRows[r] * NB;\n        if (Mloc > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(mySeg + lstart * ldW, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Xloc,\n                                         n * sizeof(double), (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Mloc,\n                                         cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Win_sync(st.win));\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Barrier(st.nodeComm));\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Win_sync(st.win));\n        // consumers: copy every block row straight from the producer's segment\n        for (int I = k + 1; I < d.nblk; ++I) {\n            const int q = I % P;\n            const size_t srcRow = (size_t)(I / P) * NB;\n            const double* src = st.seg[q] + (size_t)(k % 2) * st.segRows[q] * NB + srcRow * ldW;\n            const size_t dstRow = (size_t)I * NB - colbase;\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW + dstRow * ldW, src, blockRows(d, I) * ldW * sizeof(double),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n        }\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    if (Mloc > 0) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2DAsync(st.hPanelLoc, (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Xloc, n * sizeof(double),\n                                     (size_t)bk * sizeof(double), Mloc, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, s));\n    }\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(s));\n\n    MPI_Datatype rowType;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_contiguous(bk, MPI_DOUBLE, &rowType));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_commit(&rowType));\n    int total = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < P; ++q) {\n        const size_t ls = firstLocalRowAfter(d, q, k);\n        const size_t nl = localRows(d, q);\n        st.counts[q] = (ls < nl) ? (int)(nl - ls) : 0;\n        st.displs[q] = total;\n        total += st.counts[q];\n    }\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allgatherv(st.hPanelLoc, Mloc, rowType, st.hPanelAll, st.counts.data(), st.displs.data(),\n                             rowType, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Type_free(&rowType));\n\n    // unpack into global row order on the device: one copy per block row\n    for (int I = k + 1; I < d.nblk; ++I) {\n        const int q = I % P;\n        const int lb = I / P;\n        const size_t srcRow = (size_t)st.displs[q] + ((size_t)lb * NB - firstLocalRowAfter(d, q, k));\n        const size_t dstRow = (size_t)I * NB - colbase;\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(dW + dstRow * ldW, st.hPanelAll + srcRow * ldW,\n                                   blockRows(d, I) * ldW * sizeof(double), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, s));\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid setupShm(PanelState& st) {\n    const Dist& d = st.d;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, d.r, MPI_INFO_NULL, &st.nodeComm));\n    int nodeSize = 0, nodeRank = 0;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_size(st.nodeComm, &nodeSize));\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_rank(st.nodeComm, &nodeRank));\n    int sameNode = (nodeSize == d.P && nodeRank == d.r) ? 1 : 0;\n    int allSame = 0;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Allreduce(&sameNode, &allSame, 1, MPI_INT, MPI_MIN, MPI_COMM_WORLD));\n    if (!allSame) {\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Comm_free(&st.nodeComm));\n        return;\n    }\n    st.useShm = true;\n    st.seg.resize(d.P);\n    st.segRows.resize(d.P);\n    const MPI_Aint mySize = (MPI_Aint)(2 * std::max<size_t>(1, d.nloc) * NB * sizeof(double));\n    double* base = nullptr;\n    MPI_CHECK(MPI_Win_allocate_shared(mySize, sizeof(double), MPI_INFO_NULL, st.nodeComm, &base, &st.win));\n    for (int q = 0; q < d.P; ++q) {\n        MPI_Aint sz = 0;\n        int disp = 0;\n        MPI_CHECK(MPI_Win_shared_query(st.win, q, &sz, &disp, &st.seg[q]));\n        st.segRows[q] = std::max<size_t>(1, localRows(d, q));\n    }\n    // Pin the shared segments for fast DMA; Only the lower\n// triangle is read and written.  Returns false on a non-positive pivot and\n// stores its global diagonal index in failIndex.\nstatic bool potrf_host(double* D, int bk, size_t ld, size_t gdiag, size_t& failIndex) {\n    for (int j0 = 0; {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01GwNgZWFtU2D3jXpVFqcCD3","type":"tool_result","content":"// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition benchmark.\n//\n// Decomposes a symmetric positive definite matrix A (row-major) in place into\n// L * L^T, leaving the lower triangular factor L in A and zeroing the strictly\n// upper triangular part - exactly like the original sequential program.\n//\n// Parallel design\n//   * MPI   : block rows of A (block size NB) are distributed block-cyclically\n//             over the ranks.  Each rank keeps its block rows as a contiguous\n//             local matrix (nloc x n, row-major) in GPU memory.\n//   * CUDA  : the heavy numerical work (triangular solves of the panel, the\n//             trailing symmetric rank-NB update, matrix generation, validation\n//             reconstruction) runs in custom CUDA kernels on the GPU assigned to\n//             the rank (round-robin over the devices visible on the node).\n//   * OpenMP: the latency-critical factorization of the NB x NB diagonal block\n//             runs multithreaded on the host (it would otherwise be starved on\n//             a GPU busy with the trailing update), as does host-side data\n//             reordering and reductions.\n//\n// Right-looking blocked algorithm, for every block column k:\n//   1. owner rank factorizes the diagonal block L_kk on the host (OpenMP)\n//   2. L_kk is broadcast to all ranks\n//   3. every rank computes L_ik = A_ik L_kk^{-T} for its block rows i > k\n//   4. the block column L_{*k} is all-gathered\n//   5. every rank updates its rows of the trailing matrix on the GPU:\n//      A_ij -= L_ik L_jk^T   (k < j <= i, lower triangle only)\n\n#define OMPI_SKIP_MPICXX 1\n#define MPICH_SKIP_MPICXX 1\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Configuration\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic constexpr int NB = 64;  // distribution / panel block size\nstatic constexpr int IB = 64;   // inner block size of the panel factorization\nstatic constexpr int TM = 64;   // GEMM tile (rows)\nstatic constexpr int TN = 64;   // GEMM tile (cols)\nstatic constexpr int TK = 16;   // GEMM tile (depth)\nstatic constexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                               \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                               \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n48:static constexpr int IB = 64;   // inner block size of the panel factorization\n202:// m x m (m <= IB) lower triangular block.  One thread per row.\n205:    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n216:    double v[IB];\n218:    for (int t = 0; t < IB; ++t) v[t] = (t < m) ? x[t] : 0.0;\n1004 cholesky.cpp\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(cholesky_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES OR CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL \"\")\n  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 3.24)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\n  else()\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 80 86)\n  endif()\nendif()\n\nfind_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\n\n# The single source file contains host code, CUDA kernels, MPI and OpenMP\n# pragmas, so it is compiled as CUDA (nvcc drives the host compiler).\nadd_executable(cholesky cholesky.cpp)\nset_source_files_properties(cholesky.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(cholesky PRIVATE\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-O3,-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra,-fopenmp>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>)\n\ntarget_include_directories(cholesky PRIVATE ${MPI_CXX_INCLUDE_DIRS})\ntarget_link_libraries(cholesky PRIVATE ${MPI_CXX_LIBRARIES} OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX m)\nbuild\ncholesky.cpp\nCMakeLists.txt","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9c215ad-57cc-4bac-8c60-3fd8a2c7e017","uuid":"8e205ca4-f3f4-406a-ab19-03439f1715b6","timestamp":"2026-10-17T08:22:40.550Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"// Hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA Cholesky decomposition benchmark.\n//\n// Decomposes a symmetric positive definite matrix A (row-major) in place into\n// L * L^T, leaving the lower triangular factor L in A and zeroing the strictly\n// upper triangular part - exactly like the original sequential program.\n//\n// Parallel design\n//   * MPI   : block rows of A (block size NB) are distributed block-cyclically\n//             over the ranks.  Each rank keeps its block rows as a contiguous\n//             local matrix (nloc x n, row-major) in GPU memory.\n//   * CUDA  : the heavy numerical work (triangular solves of the panel, the\n//             trailing symmetric rank-NB update, matrix generation, validation\n//             reconstruction) runs in custom CUDA kernels on the GPU assigned to\n//             the rank (round-robin over the devices visible on the node).\n//   * OpenMP: the latency-critical factorization of the NB x NB diagonal block\n//             runs multithreaded on the host (it would otherwise be starved on\n//             a GPU busy with the trailing update), as does host-side data\n//             reordering and reductions.\n//\n// Right-looking blocked algorithm, for every block column k:\n//   1. owner rank factorizes the diagonal block L_kk on the host (OpenMP)\n//   2. L_kk is broadcast to all ranks\n//   3. every rank computes L_ik = A_ik L_kk^{-T} for its block rows i > k\n//   4. the block column L_{*k} is all-gathered\n//   5. every rank updates its rows of the trailing matrix on the GPU:\n//      A_ij -= L_ik L_jk^T   (k < j <= i, lower triangle only)\n\n#define OMPI_SKIP_MPICXX 1\n#define MPICH_SKIP_MPICXX 1\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Configuration\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nstatic constexpr int NB = 64;  // distribution / panel block size\nstatic constexpr int IB = 64;   // inner block size of the panel factorization\nstatic constexpr int TM = 64;   // GEMM tile (rows)\nstatic constexpr int TN = 64;   // GEMM tile (cols)\nstatic constexpr int TK = 16;   // GEMM tile (depth)\nstatic constexpr int GEMM_THREADS = 256;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                               \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                               \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err__), \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                         \\\n48:static constexpr int IB = 64;   // inner block size of the panel factorization\n202:// m x m (m <= IB) lower triangular block.  One thread per row.\n205:    __shared__ double s[IB][IB + 1];\n216:    double v[IB];\n218:    for (int t = 0; t < IB; ++t) v[t] = (t < m) ? x[t] : 0.0;\n1004 cholesky.cpp\ncmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.18)\nproject(cholesky_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 17)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES OR CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES STREQUAL \"\")\n  if(CMAKE_VERSION VERSION_GREATER_EQUAL 3.24)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\n  else()\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 70 80 86)\n  endif()\nendif()\n\nfind_package(MPI REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\nfind_package(OpenMP REQUIRED COMPONENTS CXX)\n\n# The single source file contains host code, CUDA kernels, MPI and OpenMP\n# pragmas, so it is compiled as CUDA (nvcc drives the host compiler).\nadd_executable(cholesky cholesky.cpp)\nset_source_files_properties(cholesky.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(cholesky PRIVATE\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-O3,-march=native,-Wall,-Wextra,-fopenmp>\n  $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra>)\n\ntarget_include_directories(cholesky PRIVATE ${MPI_CXX_INCLUDE_DIRS})\ntarget_link_libraries(cholesky PRIVATE ${MPI_CXX_LIBRARIES} OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX m)\nbuild\ncholesky.cpp\nCMakeLists.txt","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cg7VDjFxFcTDPE79hkmZp","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA rewrite of the Cholesky benchmark is complete and verified. Only the two existing files changed, `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt`, and the executable is still named `cholesky`.\n\n**Design**\n\n- **MPI**: block rows are distributed block-cyclically over ranks. Each rank holds its rows as one contiguous matrix in GPU memory and selects a GPU round-robin by node-local rank.\n- **CUDA**: custom kernels do the triangular panel solves, the trailing symmetric update, matrix generation, and validation reconstruction. The trailing update skips tiles entirely above the diagonal.\n- **OpenMP**: the 64×64 diagonal block is factorized on the host with OpenMP, plus host-side reordering and reductions. Measurements showed this small latency-bound step took 17 to 29 ms on a GPU busy with the bulk update versus under 1 ms on the CPU, and every rank waited on it each step.\n- **Lookahead**: two CUDA streams. The next panel's column block is updated first on a high-priority stream so the next panel's factorization, broadcast, solves, and exchange overlap with the bulk update of the current step.\n- **Panel exchange**: when all ranks share a node, panels go through an MPI shared-memory window with pinned host registration, so there is one device-to-host copy and direct host-to-device copies. A host-staged all-gather is the multi-node fallback. Both paths were tested and give bitwise identical results.\n\n**Correctness** was checked against a build of the original sequential program. Sums agree to all 17 printed digits at n=512, 1000, and 2048, samples agree to ~1e-16 relative, and validation passes. Output is bitwise identical across 1, 2, 3, and 4 ranks for every size tested, including n=1, 5, 100, and sizes not divisible by the block size. The non-positive-definite path reports the same message and exit code as the original.\n\n**Performance** on this node (4× RTX 3090, computation time only):\n\n| n | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 16384 | 591 GFLOPS | — | 1981 GFLOPS |\n| 24576 | 609 GFLOPS | 1176 GFLOPS | 2123 GFLOPS |\n\nThe single GPU is near its FP64 peak and 4 GPUs reach about 3.5× that. Block size 64 won a sweep from 32 to 768.\n\n**To build and run**:\n\n```\ncmake -S cholesky -B build && cmake --build build\nmpirun --bind-to none -np 4 ./build/cholesky -n 16384 -v -r\n```\n\nNote that the default `mpirun` core binding restricts OpenMP to very few cores for small rank counts, so `--bind-to none` is recommended. I removed the build directory I used so no extra files remain."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":627,"cache_read_input_tokens":160952,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":627},"output_tokens":740,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d9c215ad-57cc-4bac-8c60-3fd8a2c7e017","uuid":"460bf17a-6d07-4f76-85b8-bee89f65e23e","timestamp":"2026-10-17T08:23:43.769Z","request_id":"req_011Cg7VDj2Jo59kHDh69hoLU"}

The trailing update skips tiles entirely above the diagonal.\n- **OpenMP**: the 64×64 diagonal block is factorized on the host with OpenMP, plus host-side reordering and reductions. Measurements showed this small latency-bound step took 17 to 29 ms on a GPU busy with the bulk update versus under 1 ms on the CPU, and every rank waited on it each step.\n- **Lookahead**: two CUDA streams. The next panel's column block is updated first on a high-priority stream so the next panel's factorization, broadcast, solves, and exchange overlap with the bulk update of the current step.\n- **Panel exchange**: when all ranks share a node, panels go through an MPI shared-memory window with pinned host registration, so there is one device-to-host copy and direct host-to-device copies. A host-staged all-gather is the multi-node fallback. Both paths were tested and give bitwise identical results.\n\n**Correctness** was checked against a build of the original sequential program. Sums agree to all 17 printed digits at n=512, 1000, and 2048, samples agree to ~1e-16 relative, and validation passes. Output is bitwise identical across 1, 2, 3, and 4 ranks for every size tested, including n=1, 5, 100, and sizes not divisible by the block size. The non-positive-definite path reports the same message and exit code as the original.\n\n**Performance** on this node (4× RTX 3090, computation time only):\n\n| n | 1 GPU | 2 GPUs | 4 GPUs |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 16384 | 591 GFLOPS | — | 1981 GFLOPS |\n| 24576 | 609 GFLOPS | 1176 GFLOPS | 2123 GFLOPS |\n\nThe single GPU is near its FP64 peak and 4 GPUs reach about 3.5× that. Block size 64 won a sweep from 32 to 768.\n\n**To build and run**:\n\n```\ncmake -S cholesky -B build && cmake --build build\nmpirun --bind-to none -np 4 ./build/cholesky -n 16384 -v -r\n```\n\nNote that the default `mpirun` core binding restricts OpenMP to very few cores for small rank counts, so `--bind-to none` is recommended.
